Laplace: Ultimate Hero costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

lines.text: This pounding in my chest... This is the new hero power of Matis!
I think I can take down even more villains now! I'd like to hear what you think too, Birdie!
As long as you're by my side, there's nothing to fear.
Watch closely, Birdie! You're about to see what a real hero looks like!
Thanks to your faith in me, I've become even stronger.
Head up! Point your finger at the sky! Yes, that's it! That's the pose of a true hero! Hahaha!
I'm bursting with energy! I'm itching to do something!
There's no point in me going out there alone... I'll be waiting for you to come back, Birdie!
This peaceful sight means more to me now than ever before!
I can feel the vibrations from the armory all the way to my fingertips! My senses are much sharper now!
Maxwell's hammer sounds mightier than ever! I won't be outdone!
Laplace, the ultimate hero! I've come to light the way!
Magnificent. This is the true power of a hero.
Haha! I've surpassed yesterday's me once again!
Well done, Birdie! I swear I'll never use this power in vain!
You got this for me?! Even a true hero can't help but be touched!
Getting a gift from you makes me just as happy as powering up!
Birdie, thanks for sticking with me, even after I've changed!
Your trust is what made me a true hero.
You're so reliable, Birdie! I'm counting on you from here on out!
It's always fun being with you, Birdie! It always has been, and it always will be!
Ultimate Hero Laplace, engage!
You called, Birdie?
I'll show you the way of a true hero!
Let the battle begin!
Fear not, for the true hero is here!
No villain can stop me!
Time to put my new heroic powers to the test!
Just you wait! I'll be back after I recharge!
Ultimate Hero Power, recharging!
You're tough, I'll give you that. But I'm not losing!
Birdie, now!
Mjolnir, smite!
It's time to take down the villains!
Evil has been vanquished!
The fight isn't over!
I won't stop now!
Ugh.
Nngh.
Oof.
Sorry, Birdie. Looks like my hero power just wasn't enough...
Where there's a hero, victory is sure to follow! Hahaha!
Nice to meet you! I'm Laplace, the hero of tomorrow!
My body used to be weak, but not anymore!
I'll face every hardship head-on! I'll scale every wall in my way! And if I get knocked down, I'll just get right back up!
